title: Connectors
description: The systems HuiTong connects, their health and their field mappings.

sync.title: Choose a system to sync

descriptions.choose: HuiTong first previews what would change, and writes nothing until you apply the preview.
descriptions.preview: Nothing has been written yet. Check the changes, then slide to apply them.
descriptions.apply: Writing exactly the previewed changes to the employee master. Every change is audited.
descriptions.inSync: The preview compared every record with the employee master.
descriptions.applied: The previewed changes are in the employee master, and each one is in the audit log.
descriptions.partial: Records with errors were skipped. The other changes are in the employee master and the audit log.
descriptions.previewFailed: The preview stopped, so nothing was written. You can preview again.
descriptions.applyFailed: The sync stopped early. Any changes it made are in the audit log; preview again to pick up the rest.
descriptions.nothingToApply: Nothing can be applied: the other records match the employee master. Correct the records with errors at the source, then preview again.
descriptions.allRecordsFailed: Every record has an error, so nothing can be applied. Correct the records at the source, then preview again.
descriptions.allRecordsFailedFile: Every row has an error, so nothing can be applied. Correct the export, stage it again on the connector's page, then preview.
descriptions.nothingToApplyFile: Nothing can be applied: the other rows match the employee master. Correct the rows with errors in the export, stage it again, then preview.

sync.failed: The run stopped with an error.

errors.MAPPING_FAILED: Records could not be mapped to the employee master. Check the field mapping.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Records failed the employee master's checks.
errors.MISSING_EMPLOYEE_NO: Records arrived without an employee number.
errors.INCOMPLETE_RECORD: New records were missing required details.
errors.ENTITY_MISMATCH: Records named a different entity from the one already on file.
errors.WORK_EMAIL_IN_USE: Records carried a work email another employee already has. Check whether they are the same person, then correct the email at the source.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The run was interrupted before it finished.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The connected system did not respond.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: The source system changed after the preview, so nothing was written. Preview again to see the current changes.
errors.IMPORT_FILE_MISSING: The staged file expired or was discarded before the sync read it. Stage the file again.

sync.inSync: Everything is already in sync: there is nothing to apply.

mappings.title: Field mapping versions
mappings.description: How this system's fields become the employee master. Only an approved version is ever active.
mappings.empty: No mapping has been approved for this system yet.
mappings.caption: Field mapping, version {{version}}

import.title: Import a file
import.description: Version {{version}} of the approved mapping reads the whole export. Only the columns it maps are kept, and columns with national ID numbers or gender never are.
import.noMapping: Approve a field mapping for this system first: the import reads the file through it.
import.fileHint: The whole .csv or .xlsx export, of up to {{megabytes}} MB and {{rows}} rows.

fileProblem.missing: Choose the export file to import.
fileProblem.type: Only .csv and .xlsx files can be read.
fileProblem.size: The file is larger than {{megabytes}} MB.

import.stagedToast_one: {{count, number}} row is staged. Sync now previews it.
import.stagedToast_other: {{count, number}} rows are staged. Sync now previews them.
import.discardedToast: The staged file was discarded. Nothing was imported from it.
import.next: Next: Sync now previews what the file would change. Nothing is written until you apply the preview.
import.noPermission: Only people with permission to sync employees can import a file.

summary.label: Staged file
summary.expiresHint: A staged file is deleted after {{minutes}} minutes, or as soon as its changes are applied.
summary.stale: Mapping version {{version}} read this file, but a newer version is active now. Stage the file again to import it.

rejectedReason.DUPLICATE_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER: Line {{line}}: the same employee number as an earlier line
rejectedReason.INVALID_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER: Line {{line}}: the employee number is not in the form E123456
rejectedReason.NATIONAL_ID_VALUE: Line {{line}}: a value has the shape of a national ID number, which HuiTong never stores
rejectedReason.EXTRA_CELLS: Line {{line}}: more values than headers, so its cells may have shifted
rejectedReason.MISSING_CELLS: Line {{line}}: fewer values than headers, so its cells may have shifted
rejectedReason.INVALID_DATE: Line {{line}}: a date cell holds an impossible date

import.prohibited: Never kept: {{columns}}. HuiTong does not store national ID numbers or gender.
import.notMapped: Not read by the mapping, so not kept: {{columns}}.

problem.title: The file was not staged
problem.COLUMNS_MISSING: The approved mapping reads columns this file does not have: {{columns}}. Check that it is the right export, or approve a new mapping version for its columns.
problem.PROHIBITED_COLUMN_NATIONAL_ID: The mapping reads “{{column}}”, which holds national ID numbers. HuiTong never stores them, so the file was not staged.
problem.PROHIBITED_COLUMN_GENDER: The mapping reads “{{column}}”, which holds gender. HuiTong never stores it, so the file was not staged.
problem.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {{megabytes}} MB.
problem.WORKBOOK_TOO_LARGE: The workbook would unpack to more than {{megabytes}} MB, so it was not read. Save it as CSV, or with fewer rows, and stage it again.
problem.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than {{limit}} rows. Split it into smaller files and import each one.
problem.TOO_MANY_COLUMNS: The file has more than {{limit}} columns. Remove the columns the mapping does not read, then stage it again.
problem.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Only .csv and .xlsx files can be read.
problem.UNREADABLE: The file could not be read. Check that it is a .csv or .xlsx export and not damaged, then stage it again.
problem.NO_HEADER_ROW: The file has no header row.
problem.UNNAMED_COLUMN: Every column needs a header. Name or remove the columns without one.
problem.HEADER_TOO_LONG: A column header is longer than {{limit}} characters.
problem.DUPLICATE_HEADER: Two columns have the header “{{column}}”. Rename one, so every header is different.
problem.NO_DATA: The file has a header row but no data rows.
problem.NO_ROWS_KEPT: No row of the file can be imported. Correct these rows and stage the file again:

import.encodingDescription: This file can be read in two text encodings. Choose the one whose column headers look correct; HuiTong then reads the whole file that way.
import.noMappingReadOnly: No field mapping has been approved for this system yet. HR approves one in the mapping wizard, and then the import reads the file through it.

retired.DEPRECATED: This system is being retired, so it takes no file to import.
retired.DISABLED: This system is turned off, so it takes no file to import.

import.expiredToast: The staged file was kept for {{minutes}} minutes and has been deleted. Stage it again to import it.

transform.contains-script: Only if it has Chinese characters

wizard.title: New mapping from a sample file
wizard.description: Upload an export from a new system. The AI proposes how its columns map to the employee master; you review and approve before anything is saved.

upload.systemNameHint: How HR refers to this system, e.g. Organisation E Malaysia HR.
upload.systemNameInvalid: Enter a name of 2 to 100 characters.
upload.entityHint: The entity whose employees the file holds.
upload.languageHint: The language of the AI's reasons for each mapping.
upload.fileHint: A .csv or .xlsx export of up to 1 MB. Only the first 20 rows are read.

fileProblem.type: Only .csv and .xlsx files can be read.
fileProblem.size: The file is larger than 1 MB.

upload.sampleFailed: The sample file could not be loaded.
upload.privacy: Only the column headers, the shape of their values (for example E######) and the codes in category columns, such as departments or statuses, go to the AI. Personal values, such as names, emails or salaries, never do. Columns with national ID numbers or gender are withheld and can never be mapped.

encoding.title: Which reading of the file looks right?
encoding.description: This file can be read in two text encodings. Choose the one whose column headers look correct; the assistant then reads the file that way.

review.summary: {{mapped}} of {{total}} columns mapped, {{flagged}} flagged for a closer look (from {{rows}} sample rows).
review.caption: Proposed mapping for {{file}}
review.plainCopy: Copied as it is: check the format
review.fixedDescription: Facts the export does not contain as a column, proposed as fixed values.

problems.duplicate: {{field}} is filled from more than one column.
problems.missingEmployeeNo: A column must map to the employee number.
problems.salaryIncomplete: Base salary needs both its amount and its currency.
problems.invalid: The mapping is not valid yet.
